notes: This gate controls bounded calibration only; it does not authorize confirmatory execution.
The frozen corpus currently contains 158 cases and the calibration runner performs no retries.
Approval must bind requested model, cost ceiling, provider-call ceiling, principal and timestamp.
Provider-call ceiling is a technical call bound, not a USD hard stop. Calibration remains NO_GO until a pre-request cost hard-stop mechanism is implemented.
Calibration approval must bind the content-addressed calibration manifest; any relevant code/contract drift invalidates authorization.
